content:
@Johan Commelin asked me to write some tools to make reviewing addition of @[wikidata], @[stacks], @[kerodon] tags easier.
I've just made:

  • #39662 — feat(scripts): add cross-reference tag tooling
  • #39664 — feat(CrossRefAttribute): info-view widget for cross-reference tags
  • #39666 — feat(ci): per-PR comment summarising cross-reference tags (sample output)
  • mathlib-ci#39 — feat: orchestrator for cross-reference tag review bot

Improvements welcome.
